scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:locked
scripts.dev: npm run dev:public & npm run dev:locked
scripts.verify: npm run verify:public && npm run verify:locked
scripts.verify:public: cd apps/public-site && npm run lint && npx tsc -b && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:locked: cd apps/locked-area && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
